job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

prior_reviews.reason: The document is a 2024 RFP from the Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS RFP. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR PRIVATE EQUITY INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES Issued August 7, 2024
All proposals must be received at the address designated below no later than 2:00 P.M. CDT on Wednesday, September 4, 2024.
